formulas.name: Joint squeeze per brick
formulas.description: Joints may close up this much per brick when a ring is closed.

formulas.name: Minimum squeeze allowance
formulas.description: Lower limit of the ring squeeze allowance.

formulas.name: Extra tolerance in ring check
formulas.description: Added to the squeeze when the closure is re-checked.

formulas.name: Smallest remainder that needs a cut piece
formulas.description: A ring gap smaller than this is ignored.

formulas.name: Negative brick-count tolerance
formulas.description: A pair closes a ring if both exact counts are at least minus this value.

formulas.name: Smallest course kept
formulas.description: Courses thinner than this are dropped.

formulas.name: Partial-course tolerance
formulas.description: A course shorter than the nominal height by more than this is marked partial.

formulas.name: Brick length match tolerance
formulas.description: A pair matches a course if its length is within this of the required length.

formulas.name: Cone gap reporting threshold
formulas.description: Gaps between brick and drawn lining larger than this are reported.

formulas.name: Transition course tolerance
formulas.description: If room is shorter than the brick by more than this, the course is a transition course.

formulas.name: Flatter-than-library taper tolerance
formulas.description: Ring taper below the flattest wedge by more than this raises a flag.

formulas.name: Dish radius deviation tolerance
formulas.description: Relative difference between drawing and wedge-design radius that raises a flag (0.03 = 3 %).

formulas.name: Ring width tolerance
formulas.description: Entered ring width vs library wedge width.

formulas.name: Last-ring tolerance
formulas.description: Ring narrower than the brick pitch by more than this is a partial ring.

formulas.name: Geometry check tolerance
formulas.description: Allowed deviation between input and drawn dimensions.

formulas.name: Inside volume tolerance
formulas.description: Relative tolerance of the independent inside-volume check.

formulas.name: Lining volume rebuild tolerance
formulas.description: Relative tolerance when the lining volume is rebuilt from the brick schedule.

formulas.name: Default wall course height
formulas.description: Used when a band has no course height.

formulas.name: Default mouth course height
formulas.description: Used for the mouth band.

formulas.name: Default wall joint
formulas.description: Tangential joint per wall brick.

formulas.name: Default bottom joint
formulas.description: Bottom lining is dry-laid.

formulas.name: Default minimum cut piece
formulas.description: Smallest allowed cut brick.

formulas.name: Default cut allowance
formulas.description: Extra bricks ordered for cutting / breakage.

formulas.name: Hot-face arc length
formulas.description: Inner arc that one ring sector must fill.

formulas.name: Expansion-joint allowance
formulas.description: Number of expansion joints (one per interval of bricks) times the allowance each; taken off the cold arc.

formulas.name: Cold-face arc length
formulas.description: Outer arc of the ring less expansion gaps.

formulas.name: Hot-face radius of a horizontal brick
formulas.description: Brick laid horizontally against the permanent lining.

formulas.name: Horizontal room in a course
formulas.description: Space between cold and hot face of the drawn lining.

formulas.name: Gap between brick and drawn lining
formulas.description: Positive on cones: the drawn lining is wider than the brick.

formulas.name: Radius closed by one shape alone
formulas.description: Hot-face radius where a single tapered brick shape closes a full ring.

formulas.name: Closure determinant
formulas.description: Determinant of the two ring-closure equations for A and B bricks.

formulas.name: Exact number of A bricks
formulas.description: Solves  nA(hotA+j) + nB(hotB+j) = inner arc  and  nA(coldA+j) + nB(coldB+j) = outer arc.

formulas.name: Exact number of B bricks
formulas.description: See number of A bricks.

formulas.name: Count when both shapes have the same taper
formulas.description: One shape only.

formulas.name: Ring remainder
formulas.description: Arc left after na A-bricks and nb B-bricks (ia, ib = hot widths + joint).

formulas.name: Joint squeeze allowance
formulas.description: How much the joints may close up over the whole ring.

formulas.name: Whole extra bricks that fit
formulas.description: Added when the remainder holds another brick after squeezing.

formulas.name: A bricks for a chosen B count
Length of each of two cut pieces
formulas.description: A too-small remainder is shared by two cut pieces.

formulas.name: Cone gap volume (per course sector)
formulas.description: Volume between the horizontal brick and the sloping hot face.

formulas.name: Cold-sphere radius of the wedge design
formulas.description: Sphere radius for which the SH wedge brick was made.

formulas.name: Ring radial pitch
formulas.description: Width of one ring plus its joint.

formulas.name: Circumference
formulas.description: Ring circle at radius r.

formulas.name: Arc taken by stirring elements
formulas.description: Deducted from both ring circumferences.

formulas.name: Ring taper ratio
formulas.description: Outer / inner circumference.

formulas.name: Sector fraction of a full revolution
Volume of a revolved region (Pappus)
formulas.description: 2π × first moment of the cross-section about the axis × sector fraction; unit_factor = 1e-9 converts mm³ to m³.

formulas.name: Specific volume
formulas.description: Inside volume per tonne of heat size.

formulas.name: Stirring element angular pitch
formulas.description: Elements are evenly spaced on the PCD.
